title: Geist in the Machine: Simulating Recognition and Inner Dialogue in AI-Mediated Teaching and Research
reasoning: The paper is grounded in Hegelian recognition theory and Freudian psychodynamics, using these philosophical and psychoanalytic frameworks to design AI prompts and evaluate tutor behavior. It specifically benchmarks dimensions such as 'epistemic integrity' and 'mutual recognition,' which are central to social epistemology and ethical relations in pedagogical contexts.
